title: 棉花糖可可
style: soft marshmallow sculpture, powdery yellow sugar, chocolate eyes, cocoa tabletop
beats: The face sinks slightly into a cocoa-colored cushion
An orange marshmallow bubble puffs at the cheek
The bubble bounces onto the cushion
It stretches into a short marshmallow string
The string pulls the bubble back
The face and cheek return to their original softness
